newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Benchmark All Ords Trust makes debut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Benchmark All Ords Trust makes debut.

text.p: Units in the Benchmark Australian All Ordinaries Index Trust made their debut on the Australian Stock Exchange at A$25.12, marginally higher than their calculated issue price of A$25.05436.
The issue was underwritten by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell with the trust's purpose being to mimick the performance of the All Ordinaries index, the Australian Stock Exchange's benchmark indicator.
